title: Stack Nudge job guards: who gets nudged about stacked PRs
answers: who gets the stacked PR nudge comment
why did the bot skip my native stack PR
stacked PR advice not showing for external contributor
where is the stacked PR advice now, advice.js or stack-nudge workflow
body:
Invariant: the nudge job posts only when the PR author_association is MEMBER, OWNER or COLLABORATOR, the author is not type Bot, the body contains the phrase "🥞 Stacked PR", and the PR is not already a native stack (`!github.event.pull_request.stack`).
Enforced in: .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge (the job-level `if:` expression).
What breaks if skipped: external contributors and bots get nudged, and PRs already on GitHub's native stacks get told to use native stacks.
Constraint: the stacked-PR advice was removed from .github/workflows/advice.js. Add stacked-PR logic in stack-nudge.yml, not in advice.js.
Constraint: the job-level `contains(body, '🥞 Stacked PR')` is case-sensitive. Any content matcher must not be stricter than this prefilter, or valid descriptions are silently skipped (a review comment asked for case-insensitive matching).
applies: Changes to when or for whom the Stack Nudge workflow fires.
says: The bot should not suggest stacked pull requests on pull requests already using native stacks.
Automated stack advice comments should not be sent to external community contributors.
Prevent automated bot accounts from receiving tips about stacked pull requests.
The stacked pull request comment did not post because the header had different casing.
Why did the stacked pull request recommendation skip my pull request?
search: In .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge, the job-level if condition ensures the stacked PR advice job runs only for non-bot MEMBER, OWNER, or COLLABORATOR authors on PRs with '🥞 Stacked PR' in the body that are not already native stacks (!github.event.pull_request.stack). Stacked PR advice must be added in stack-nudge.yml rather than .github/workflows/advice.js. The contains(body, '🥞 Stacked PR') check is case-sensitive, and downstream content matchers must not be stricter than this prefilter.
